reviewSamples.author: Photo of Michael Best
reviewSamples.text: James and crew are great people to work with. I live down the street from him and he also takes care of many other yards in our neighborhood. He cuts weekly in the summer and every other week in the fall / winter months. Everytime he cuts he edges and blows. I also have him keep the shrubs trimmed up.
